package: K35-T1 Studio video deletion and durable local storage cleanup

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped after test
flow: Studio DELETE removes the video and cascaded originals, assets and playback routes
the same transaction persists a STORAGE_CLEANUP durable job with a manifest of two HLS assets and two originals
the local cleanup runner marks the job DONE
all original and HLS objects for the video are absent from the loopback S3-shaped fixture

limitations: All storage operations used the loopback S3-shaped test fixture; no Cloudflare R2 or deployed Worker was contacted.
Browser playback is verified for version 1; version 2 is verified by Studio API, worker, DB and active route, not a second browser session.
This covers deletion of this synthetic video, not a broad role/state matrix, payment profiles or independent review; K35 remains partial.
